regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and aggregate claim of phosphine/silver-controlled access to CF3-substituted allenones or furans. The abstract is a summary, not an experiment-specific arrow.

regions.region: page 1 two-column introduction and Figure 1 discussion
regions.finding: Separated cited enyne difunctionalization, fluoride-addition, and phosphine-acylation background from the current generic acylfluorination design; detailed Figure 1 panels occur on page 2.
The no-product PCy3 experiment is the prose introduction to Table 1 entry 1 on page 2 and is represented once with cross-page evidence.

unresolved: Generic Figure 1 structures contain R/FG labels and do not define unique molecules or conditions.
No workspace Supporting Information association is established.

regions.finding: Classified panels a-c as prior/background reaction classes and panel d as the present generic design. No panel was assigned a scope-row yield.

regions.region: page 2 left-center Table 1 reaction header, entries 1-9, and footnotes a-b
regions.finding: All nine rows were recorded independently with 1a/2a/MeCN charges, catalyst/additive presence or dash omission, 20/15 mol% loadings, room temperature/Ar/16 h, 19F-NMR 3aa yield, starting-material recovery, and no detected 2-position-acylated product.
Mapped named acyl-source and difluoroenyne outcomes to the individual Scheme 1 and Scheme 2 arrows on pages 3-4; the ordinary 3ia and 10 mmol gram-scale 3ia results remain separate.

Retained the preliminary 6% AgF-switch observation and the no-AgF failure as incomplete main-text records. The later optimized 4gn result is linked to its distinct Scheme 2b row; undefined excess-phosphine effects were not converted into a fabricated dose.

unresolved: SI Tables S1-S3 are unassociated and were not imported.
The exact substrates and full conditions of the preliminary 6%/no-AgF furan optimization observations are not printed in the main text.
Several scope-yield bases are not stated in Scheme 2.

regions.finding: Recorded eleven ordinary 0.2 mmol arrows 3aa-3ka and a separate 10 mmol benzoyl-fluoride 3ia repeat, preserving all isolated yields and shared Xantphos/CsF/MeCN/room-temperature/Ar/16 h conditions.

regions.region: page 3 middle Scheme 1b carboxylic-acid grid and footnotes c-d
regions.finding: Recorded eight distinct two-stage experiments. Each has 0 °C/10 min DAST acyl-fluoride formation with short-silica isolation, followed by Xantphos and row-specific CsF or AgF at room temperature for 16 h; final isolated yields remain attached to the displayed two-step experiment.
The 4kn/4un/4vn and 4ho-4ht discussion maps to the page-4 Scheme 2b arrows. Only 4vn is explicitly described as isolated in the prose; other yield bases remain missing.
Classified int1-int6 and both catalytic branches as a proposed mechanism, not isolated preparations. References to SI Schemes S2/S3 do not establish SI association.

unresolved: Scheme 1 omits workups, final purifications, masses, and several scale denominators.
Intermediate acyl-fluoride amounts/yields in the two-step rows are not reported.
Proposed intermediates are not independently observed.

regions.finding: Recorded twelve distinct 3ab-3am arrows with shared 2a/Xantphos/fluoride/MeCN conditions and footnote-b AgF replacement for 3aj/3ak. The 3al and 3am failures retain 0% product and 42%/47% starting-material recovery separately.

regions.region: page 4 middle/lower Scheme 2b silver-catalyzed furan scope
regions.finding: Recorded fifteen distinct 4an-4ht arrows at AgF 40 mol%, Xantphos 20 mol%, MeCN 0.2 M, 50 °C, Ar, 3 h on 0.2 mmol scale with purified acyl fluoride; every displayed yield targets its product.

regions.region: page 4 Scheme 2 caption and footnotes a-b
regions.finding: Applied the 0.2 mmol/purified-acyl-fluoride caption to each row and represented CsF-to-AgF replacement as a participant change, not a note-only exception.

unresolved: Scheme 2 does not identify the 0.2 mmol scale denominator, ordinary yield/recovery bases, workups, purifications, or masses.
Compact products remain source-labeled where safe structures were uncertain.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left Scheme 3 possible catalytic cycle
regions.finding: The original image confirms the phosphine 1,4-acylfluorination branch and silver 1,2-acylfluorination/cyclization branch through int1-int6. It is one mechanism record, not six preparations.

regions.region: page 5 lower-left declaration, acknowledgments, and supplementary-material statement
regions.finding: Administrative/funding text only. The publisher states online supplementary material exists, but workspace SI association remains unestablished and no SI fact was imported.
Bibliography/prior-literature citations only; external papers were not expanded into current-paper experiments.

unresolved: Mechanistic intermediates have no independent quantities, yields, or observation status.
The online supplementary-material statement does not establish a workspace SI association.
No current-paper experimental arrow beyond Scheme 3 occurs on this page.
